primary_source.discovery: Linked from original EEX German nEHS Data page; current download snapshot, not authenticated contemporaneous archive.

read_extent: All eleven original result rows and field names read, sums independently recalculated.
assessment: Primary results support rounded 192.1 million allowances, 12.5 billion EUR revenue, 5.2 billion bids, 27-fold demand, 3.7 percent allocation, 109 mean bidders and eleven auctions, all clearing at EUR65. A preliminary February calendar is not a valid counter to actual July–September outcomes.
limits: Does not validate market-power, distributional-incidence or future-cost conclusions; concentration figures from the separate DEHSt report were not independently checked.
